situations.headline: Blank-check shell Unite Acquisition 2 completes reverse merger with Blue Laser Fusion, becomes de-shelled operating company

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Blank-check shell Unite Acquisition 2 completes reverse merger with Blue Laser Fusion, becomes de-shelled operating company (interest 6, risk 8)

thesis.text: Blue Laser Fusion enters public markets via reverse merger into a blank-check shell, funded by a $25-50M private placement; thesis is highly speculative pending disclosure of fusion technology milestones, use of proceeds, cap table dilution from the exchange ratio, and audited financials — track closely for the Super 8-K financial statements and post-merger capitalization detail before forming a valuation view.
